name: João Oliveira - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on developing a new EU anti-poverty strategy
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to draw up a new plan to fight poverty across the EU. It wants a goal of ending poverty by 2035, more money for children and families, decent pay and minimum income, and better access to housing, healthcare, water and energy. It also asks that people who have lived in poverty help shape the policies. This is the Parliament's opinion; it does not change any law by itself.

- The Commission is asked to propose an anti-poverty strategy with a 2035 poverty target and a dedicated budget.
- It affects people at risk of poverty, especially children, women, single parents, Roma and disabled people.
- Next, the Commission decides whether to act on these requests; the Parliament would then scrutinise any proposal.
